messages.subject: Developing R Packages and CRAN Publishing - Livestream Seminar
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is pleased to be offering a 1-day seminar on Developing R Packages and CRAN Publishing, running Jan 23 by Dr Fodil Ihaddaden, an expert in this area with significant experience writing and publishing R packages on CRAN. This seminar is an excellent opportunity for R users to learn how to create, document, and publish their own R packages on CRAN. Whether you are new to package development or looking to refine your skills, this course will provide the foundational knowledge needed to confidently share your work with the R community. Participants will cover essential topics such as structuring R packages, writing effective documentation, managing dependencies, and navigating the CRAN submission process. With a focus on practical applications, the seminar equips attendees with the tools necessary to develop high-quality, reusable R packages.

Don’t miss this chance to learn from an expert—sign up today to secure your spot!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
